$metadata.description: Extract rate schedules and charges from utility tariff documents

quality_checks.message: Rate should be numeric when applicable

title: Electric Utility Rate Tariff Extraction Schema - Hierarchical
description: Extract rate schedules with charges hierarchically, then consolidate to flat format. SCOPE: Residential, commercial, and industrial electric rates. EXCLUDE: Gas, water, telecommunications, fee schedules.

applies_to_electric_rates.description: Does this document contain electric utility rate schedules?

extraction_approach.description: Document which rate schedules were extracted. Format: 'Extracted [schedules]; Excluded [schedules]'
examples: Extracted Schedule R, RD, RE-TOU, C, C-TOU, SG (residential & commercial); Excluded fee schedules and riders

utility_info.description: Utility context that will be added to every charge row during consolidation.

tariff_book_name.description: Tariff book name exactly as written (e.g., 'COLO. PUC No. 8 Electric'). Null if not specified.

service_area.description: Service territory exactly as written. Null if not specified.

regulatory_authority.description: Regulatory commission exactly as written. Null if not specified.

rate_schedules.description: ALL standard rate schedules in the tariff. CRITICAL: Extract EVERY standard rate schedule listed in the table of contents - residential (R, RD, RE-TOU, R-OO), commercial (C, C-TOU, SG), industrial, lighting, etc. Do NOT stop after 2-3 schedules. Most tariffs have 5-15+ schedules. EXCLUDE: Fee schedules, rider schedules, terms/conditions.

rate_name.description: Rate schedule name exactly as written (e.g., 'Schedule R', 'Rate C-TOU').

tariff_section.description: Sheet/section number exactly as written. Null if not specified.

effective_date.description: Effective date exactly as written. Null if not specified.

sector.description: Customer sector (e.g., 'Residential', 'Commercial', 'Industrial'). Null if not specified.

service_type.description: Service type (e.g., 'Bundled', 'Standby', 'Time-of-use'). Null if not specified.

customer_class.description: Customer classification. Null if not specified.

voltage_category.description: Voltage level exactly as written. Null if not specified.

description.description: Schedule description and applicability. Null if not provided.

charges.description: All charges for this rate schedule. Each charge will become one row in the consolidated output.

charge_description.description: Specific charge name from tariff. Null if not provided.

rate.description: Rate value (number for fixed rates, string for variable). Null if not applicable.

unit.description: Unit exactly as written (e.g., '$', '$/kWh', '$/kW'). Null if not applicable.

rate_structure.description: Rate structure (e.g., 'Flat', 'Tiered', 'Time-of-use', 'Seasonal'). Null if not applicable.

season.description: Season exactly as written. Null if not applicable.

season_months.description: Month range exactly as written. Null if not applicable.

time_period.description: Time-of-use period (e.g., 'On-Peak', 'Off-Peak'). Null if not applicable.

time_range.description: Clock hours exactly as written. Null if not applicable.

tier_min_kwh.description: Minimum kWh for tiered rate. Null if not tiered.

tier_max_kwh.description: Maximum kWh for tiered rate. Null if not tiered.

measurement_period.description: How demand is measured (e.g., '15-minute interval'). Null if not applicable.

conditions.description: Special conditions for this charge. Null if none.

extracted_text.description: Complete charge text verbatim from tariff. CRITICAL FOR QA/QC.

tariff_location.description: Page/sheet number where charge appears. Null if not traceable.
